definitions.explanation: A tool used for measuring and drawing angles, usually semicircular with degree markings.

examples.japanese: {分度器|ぶんどき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{角度|かくど}→角度：00156_kakudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: To measure an angle with a protractor.

examples.japanese: {分度器|ぶんどき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧60⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かく}→角：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: To draw a 60-degree angle using a protractor.

examples.japanese: {分度器|ぶんどき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ってきてください→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧。
examples.english: Please bring a protractor and ruler.

notes:
{分度器|ぶんどき} is a protractor, a semicircular tool marked in degrees used for measuring and drawing angles.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{分度|ぶんど}→分度：noentry⟧ (dividing degrees) + ⟦{器|き}→器：noentry⟧ (instrument).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {分度器|ぶんどき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure with a protractor
- {分度器|ぶんどき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a protractor
- {分度器|ぶんどき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to place a protractor (against something)

RELATED GEOMETRY TOOLS:
- ⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧: ruler
- ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧: set square / triangle ruler
- コンパス: compass (for drawing circles)
- ⟦{直定規|ちょくじょうぎ}→直定規：noentry⟧: straightedge

USAGE:
Introduced in Japanese elementary school math (⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧) when students learn about angles. Part of the standard ⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧ (stationery) set for geometry.
